data.name: American Navy SEALs
data.detailed_description:
Inspired by the tactical shooter that defined a generation. Rebuilt for the next one. Powered by Unreal Engine 5.

Twenty years ago, an elite squad redefined what it meant to lead a team into impossible odds. Now, the legend returns — bigger, deadlier, and more cinematic than ever.

Step into the boots of Lieutenant Commander, leader of an elite SEAL fireteam deployed across the world's most volatile flashpoints. From the snow-choked mountains of the Hindu Kush to the neon-drenched megacities of Southeast Asia, every breath you take could be your last — and every shot you fire could change the course of history.

FEATURES:

NEXT-GEN TACTICAL COMBAT — Experience pulse-pounding first-person gunplay built from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5. Photorealistic environments, volumetric weather, ray-traced lighting, and Lumen-powered global illumination put you closer to the fight than ever before.

COMMAND YOUR FIRETEAM — Issue orders to three AI squadmates using an intuitive radial command wheel. Flank, breach, suppress, extract. Every call matters. Every life is yours to protect.

A GLOBAL WAR ON SHADOWS — A sweeping 12-mission single-player campaign penned by industry veterans takes you across five continents to dismantle a shadow network threatening to ignite World War III.

AUTHENTIC ARSENAL — Over 60 meticulously modeled real-world weapons, attachments, and gadgets. Modify your loadout for every mission, from silent infiltration to full-spectrum dominance.

MISSION-DRIVEN STORYTELLING — Iconic mission-briefing sequences, gritty radio chatter, and cinematic in-engine cutscenes deliver the atmospheric military authenticity that defined a generation, rebuilt for a new one.

THE LEGEND ENDURES — Earn your Trident across deepening difficulty tiers — from Recruit to Tier One Operator. Unlock veteran skins, classified mission files, and challenge modes that test even the most decorated player.

The Trident is yours. Earn it.

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD R9 380 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
